name: Fuel Targets

name: Fuel Compensation Main
output: % of plenum air entering the cylinder
note: 100 means all measured plenum air; values above 100 add pulse width and values below 100 subtract it.

name: Fuel Compensation Cold
output: % of plenum air entering the cylinder
note: Used during warm-up; the ECU switches to Main at 70 °C coolant temperature.

name: K - Fuel Multiplier
note: The same scalar that ProECU calls 'BFS Multiplier (K-Factor)' and A2L calls 'K-Value'. A2L 'MAF Factor' is a separate airflow scalar.

name: Mass Air Flow Sensor
source: Fuel Parameters / Mass Air Flow Sensor
note: The axis is static and cannot be edited. Corresponds to ProECU 'MAF Sensor Scaling Bank #1/#2 (V to %)'.

name: Cranking Enrichment Initial Value
source: Fuel Parameters / Cranking Enrichment Initial Value
note: The first injection event during cranking. The axis is static. Incorrect calibration causes P0300.

name: Injector Priming Pulse Mode 1
source: Fuel Parameters / Injector Priming Pulse Mode 1 - 4
note: 100% is the slowest decay and keeps the mixture rich longer; 0% is the fastest transition to measured airflow.

name: Injector Priming Pulse Mode 2
source: Fuel Parameters / Injector Priming Pulse Mode 1 - 4

name: Injector Priming Pulse Mode 3
source: Fuel Parameters / Injector Priming Pulse Mode 1 - 4

name: Injector Priming Pulse Mode 4
source: Fuel Parameters / Injector Priming Pulse Mode 1 - 4

name: Injector Priming Pulse by RPM 1
output: % multiplier for Cranking Enrichment Initial Value
source: Fuel Parameters / Injector Priming Pulse by RPM 1 - 4
note: The axis is static. 100% uses the entire pulse width from Initial Value.

name: Injector Priming Pulse by RPM 2
source: Fuel Parameters / Injector Priming Pulse by RPM 1 - 4

name: Injector Priming Pulse by RPM 3
source: Fuel Parameters / Injector Priming Pulse by RPM 1 - 4

name: Injector Priming Pulse by RPM 4
source: Fuel Parameters / Injector Priming Pulse by RPM 1 - 4

name: Cylinder Trim
note: 100 leaves the value unchanged, 80 multiplies the pulse by 0.8, and 120 multiplies it by 1.2. ProECU calls this 'Fuel Trim Per Cylinder'; neither vendor is certain whether the index is cylinder number or firing order.

name: Injector Minimum
note: The minimum pulse width that the ECU issues in normal modes. ProECU calls this 'Injector Minimum Open Time'.

name: Fuel Target Lookup Delay
source: Fuel Parameters / Fuel Target Lookup Delay
note: Zero in most ROMs and nonzero in some V8 ROMs. The delay applies when the AFR target differs from 14.7.

name: Calculated Load
note: The axis is static. Load = current BFS / table value for the current speed. ProECU calls this '100% Engine Load' and gives a factory value of 39.8 BFS.

name: Load Point Scaler
note: The primary parameter for injector changes; it shifts every table whose load is expressed through BFS. UpRev recommends changing this scalar instead of the load-axis values.

name: Ignition Timing Trim Main
source: Ignition Advance Parameters / Ignition Timing Trim / Burn Rate
note: The main normal-operation table. UpRev provides no conversion to degrees BTDC; A2L provides the 'Degrees Adjustment (x-64)' scale.

name: Ignition Timing Trim High Det
source: Ignition Advance Parameters / Ignition Timing Trim / Burn Rate
note: Used when the ECU detects excessive knock-sensor activity; the transition is visible in the logged High Det Flag parameter (0 -> 1).

name: Ignition Timing Trim Cold
source: Ignition Advance Parameters / Ignition Timing Trim / Burn Rate
note: Present only in later Nissan ECUs; used below 70 °C coolant temperature, after which the ECU switches to Main.

name: Ignition Timing Knock Windows
source: Ignition Advance Parameters / Ignition Timing Knock Windows
note: Shares axes with the ignition tables. Available only to professional tuners. ProECU calls this 'Knock Control Enable'.

name: Knock Listening Threshold
source: Ignition Advance Parameters / Knock Listening Threshold
note: Neither UpRev nor ProECU provides an exact conversion to a kHz scale. Higher values filter more noise. ProECU calls this 'Knock Sensitivity'.

name: Cam Phasing
note: ProECU calls this 'VTC Valve Advance' in °Crank.

name: Rev Limit
note: The value is engine speed directly. ProECU calls this 'Rev Limit - Fuel Cut' but does not identify its axis.

name: Throttle Cut Rev Limit
note: UpRev recommends setting it at least 100 RPM below fuel cut because throttle closure is safer than repeated fuel-cut impacts.

name: Throttle A
note: The ECU uses this torque to reduce throttle opening and ignition advance during shifts. A ratio mismatch against Estimated Torque Delivered causes P0605.

name: Acc. Throttle Request Low Speed
note: The table set depends on the ROM, ranging from two tables (Low/High Speed) to many tables (Low, High, Cold, Warm, Idle, Snow, Sport, Eco).

name: Acc. Throttle Request Low Speed (Alt)
note: Validation copy: it must match the main table or P0605 is set. ProECU calls the same mechanism 'Trustful'.

name: Acc. Throttle Request High Speed
note: P0605 is set if Low Speed requests a larger angle than High Speed; the reverse relation is permitted.

name: Acc. Throttle Request High Speed (Alt)
note: Validation copy.

name: Throttle Opening Area of Duct Area Calculation
source: Electronic Throttle / Throttle Opening Area of Duct Area Calculation
note: Calibrated when larger-diameter throttle bodies are installed.

name: Throttle Valve Opening Target 1
source: Electronic Throttle / Throttle Valve Opening Target
note: Works with Throttle Opening Area of Duct Area Calculation; UpRev recommends preserving the ratio between them.

name: Throttle Valve Opening Target 2
source: Electronic Throttle / Throttle Valve Opening Target
note: Must exactly match Throttle Valve Opening Target 1.

name: Throttle Flow Potential for Fuel Comp X Trace Low
source: Electronic Throttle / Throttle Flow Potential for Fuel Comp X Trace (Low & High)
note: Defines the Volumetric Flow Ratio axis of the Fuel Compensation map.

name: Throttle Flow Potential for Fuel Comp X Trace High
source: Electronic Throttle / Throttle Flow Potential for Fuel Comp X Trace (Low & High)

name: Estimated Torque Delivered
note: Present in every ROM but used only with automatic transmissions: the value is sent to the TCM for line-pressure calculation. ProECU calls this 'Torque Actual'.

name: Target Drive Force
note: Influences gear selection by pedal position. Wheel torque = Throttle A Torque * calculated gear ratio. Alt tables must match exactly or P0605 is set. Sub Operation Mode is used for towing.

name: Radiator Fan Speed by Temp
note: Nissan introduced this three-dimensional table in 2009 for some applications. ProECU calls it 'Radiator Fan Duty'.

name: Radiator Fan Speed by A/C Pressure (Upper)
note: Corresponds to ProECU 'Radiator Fan A/C ON' and 'Radiator Fan A/C Related'.

name: Radiator Fan Speed by A/C Pressure (Lower)
Coolant Temp Fan Switch Point
note: Legacy layout: three switch-point windows with Low and High constants. They remain in the ECU but are unused on some models, providing a direct source of tables with the dead role.

name: Idle Target
note: The axis is static. ProECU calls the Neutral and Drive variants 'Idle Target #1/#2' but does not name the axis.

name: Idle Target Gear
note: The axis is static. Target with a gear engaged, excluding Neutral and Park; automatic transmissions only.

name: Idle Target Low
note: The axis is static. Target under additional HVAC, electrical, and power-steering-pump load. ProECU does not name it.

name: Crank Drag A
source: Misfire / Crank Drag A, B and C
note: Higher values make misfire codes harder to trigger. Requires adjustment when a supercharger is installed.

name: Crank Drag B
source: Misfire / Crank Drag A, B and C

name: Crank Drag C
source: Misfire / Crank Drag A, B and C

name: Crank Drag Crank Angle Pulse Width 1
source: Misfire / Crank Drag Crank Angle Pulse Width 1-4
note: Values set too low cause oversensitive P0300-P0308 detection.

name: Crank Drag Crank Angle Pulse Width 2
source: Misfire / Crank Drag Crank Angle Pulse Width 1-4

name: Crank Drag Crank Angle Pulse Width 3
source: Misfire / Crank Drag Crank Angle Pulse Width 1-4

name: Crank Drag Crank Angle Pulse Width 4
source: Misfire / Crank Drag Crank Angle Pulse Width 1-4

name: ETC Control
note: Disables electronic-throttle torque control so the throttle follows the pedal linearly. Also disables cruise control.

name: NATS
note: JK03A/JK08A contains a factory Developer Immobilizer flag at 0x8725: clearing bit0 bypasses the state machine and releases motor inhibit.

name: VVEL Angle
output: VVEL shaft angle versus cam duration
note: Prevents valve contact. ProECU calls this 'VVEL Control Shaft Angle to Duration'.

name: VVEL Angle Alt
output: VVEL shaft angle versus cam duration
note: Validation copy that must always match VVEL Angle.

name: VVEL Decel
note: Engine-braking mode. ProECU calls this 'VVEL Valve Duration Overrun'.

name: VVEL Intake Phasing
note: The angle requested by Cam Advance WOT must not exceed this table value. ProECU calls this 'VTC Max Advance by VVEL CS Angle'.

name: VVEL Limit
note: The inverse side of the same protection. ProECU calls this 'VVEL Control Shaft Max by VTC Angle'.

name: VVEL Main Drivability
note: The primary normal-operation table. ProECU calls it the 3D map 'VVEL Valve Duration Main'.

name: VVEL Main Drivability High Detonation
note: High-detonation-mode variant that ProECU does not name.

name: VVEL Max
note: ProECU presents this as a control-shaft-angle limit by engine speed.

name: VVEL Duration WOT
note: Full-throttle mode. ProECU calls this 'VVEL Valve Duration WOT'.

name: Cruise Enabled
note: Found on 2003-2008 vehicles without intelligent cruise; enables map switching when the required hardware is connected, but does not enable cruise control itself.

name: Enable Manual Transmission Swap
note: For 2003-2008 VQ35 and 2009+ VQ37VHR ROMs: the ECU ignores automatic-transmission tables.

name: Single Bank Fuel Trim O2 Hack
source: Toggles / Single Bank Fuel Trim O2 Hack
note: Disables closed-loop feedback from the bank 2 oxygen sensor. Developed for QR25.

name: Simplified Timing Map 1
note: ARC patch. The axes are fully independent from the factory ignition table, allowing higher resolution.

name: Knock Correction
note: ARC patch.

name: Oil temperature Correction
note: ARC patch. Works only on vehicles with a factory oil-temperature sensor; otherwise coolant temperature is used.

name: Coolant Temperature Correction
note: ARC patch.

name: Intake Air Temperature Correction
source: Simplified Timing (ARC) / Intake Air Temperature Correction
note: ARC patch.

name: Simplified Timing Load Activation
note: ARC patch. Simplified timing activates when BFS is at or above the threshold, regardless of engine speed.

name: Simplified Timing RPM Activation
note: ARC patch.
